page: Microsoft Azure L24aos_v4 is a storage and memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Laosv4 family. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor with x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The server features 24 dedicated vCPUs derived from 12 physical cores with multithreading enabled. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. A key hardware highlight is the inclusion of 17279 GB of local storage, and the instance is Premium Storage capable.

In benchmark evaluations, the L24aos_v4 demonstrates strong single-core performance, placing in the top 25% for both stress-ng single-core tests and Geekbench single-core scores. Multi-core performance, including stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core, falls within the average range. Memory bandwidth tests for both cached and uncached read/write operations also register average results. For specialized workloads, the server achieves top-tier performance in text generation for small 135M parameter language models, though prompt processing for large 70B parameter models is weak.

The hardware profile of the L24aos_v4 offers high resource density, particularly regarding its massive local storage capacity relative to the 24 vCPUs. This makes it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for workloads requiring substantial local data caching without the overhead of external storage attachments. The server is well-suited for large-scale databases, data warehousing, memory-intensive applications, and local file processing.
description: The Microsoft Azure L24aos_v4 is a storage-focused virtual machine from the Laosv4 family, powered by a 3.7 GHz AMD EPYC 9V74 processor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs, 192.0 GB of RAM, and a massive 17279 GB of local storage. Operating on the x86_64 architecture under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this server delivers strong single-core performance, ranking in the top 25% in Geekbench and stress-ng single-core benchmarks. Multi-core performance and memory bandwidth remain in the average tier. With its high storage-to-compute ratio and Premium Storage capability, the L24aos_v4 is highly efficient for data-intensive workloads. It is best suited for large databases, high-capacity caching, and memory-intensive applications.
